instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that letter under my plate. I've approved breakfast together, and we're finally managing one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother canceled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This month's rent is covered. Discussion of another suitcase in the hall is not on today's menu.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then may I open the letter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. Yesterday you finally unpacked. I'm insisting on one whole breakfast with you before I risk a conversation that sends you packing again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The missing savings are a banking complication. Our anniversary dinner is going ahead; I've confirmed it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Questions about my sister are deferred until Friday, when the money comes back. Last time, you asked for separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll ring the bank. May I have the statement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That inquiry is staying with me. You may choose the anniversary menu. I'd like us still sharing a table when this is settled.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now I'm back, I'm giving you the first word: admit the flat was too quiet without me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reciprocity is approved, in that order. Did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every evening. There, your turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is granted. I rang our landline just to hear you. Now you may say hello again, and I'll try not to pretend I called about a bill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm not authorizing the return of my chair cushion until you explain why you kept the chair and sold the sofa.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything for it. Can I have the cushion now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. If someone offered twenty pounds, would you still keep the chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cushion return approved. I'll admit I sleep with it. You may take the price sticker off the chair; I'd rather sit with you than keep borrowing its company.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved coffee together on Sunday. That year apart was healthy for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist on every Saturday, whatever else I wanted to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The break taught us to have separate lives. I'm authorizing a much more flexible arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday. Can coffee wait?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Monday is approved. See how well the break worked? You've requested a whole extra day apart, and I haven't called an emergency meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've limited lunch to the two of us. That disastrous family reunion did us a favor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I've accepted the lesson: no audience to make us compete. You may finish a sentence today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter asked whether we're expecting twelve more. Shall I tell him no?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Two is the approved number. We're applying what we learned; nobody has to storm out before you get a turn.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. We can fix last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Of course. Listening stage. I'll write down anything I want to interrupt with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll be writing instead of listening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you keep the pen. Supervised listening. If I interrupt, write it down; we'll start with that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're on stage two of repairing yesterday's shouting match. Choose a biscuit; I've taken charge of getting us talking again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What was stage one? I only came back for my coat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Getting you to ask about the process. Your participation is approved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't got a process. You're inventing this around whatever I say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good honesty. I'm authorizing that as stage three. Put the coat down and tell me the next thing; we're making excellent progress.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've kept twelve tickets from our trips. Submit your total before you claim you care as much as I do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I kept mine in the album I made for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The album is under my protection. I award myself the extra care required to preserve your gift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I reinforced every page so your tickets could go in with mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reinforcement approved. Put my tickets in too; I'll get a waterproof cover. You're providing memories, but I'm protecting both our collections.
